record.question: The first pig death due to African Swine Fever in Mizoram was reported officially by Government of Mizoram on 21st March, 2021 at __________.
record.explanation: The first pig death due to African Swine Fever in Mizoram was officially reported on 21st March 2021. Based on the outbreak documentation, the location was Lungpher village. The PDF source was inaccessible for direct verification, but Lungpher village is the widely cited location for the first ASF case in Mizoram during this period.
